description: Search OrtakListe's free catalogue of ready-made lists and recipes (grocery, Turkish recipes, healthy/vegan, parties, travel, camping, moving house, baby, emergency kits, hobbies). The query can be in any language. Each result has a page URL to cite and a prefilled_list_url that opens the list ready to share.

language.description: Language for titles, descriptions and links: tr, en, es, de or fr. Use the user's language.

query.description: What the user needs, e.g. 'camping', 'lentil soup', 'earthquake kit'.

name: search_ready_made_lists
